verdict.rationale: The evidence only glancingly touches API-driven dispute handling: webhooks report "progress on disputes", there is a dedicated disputes-testing section in the sandbox, and there is a dispute-management docs area. However, nothing documents API endpoints to retrieve a dispute, upload evidence, or submit a response. The MCP server's listed operations (payment status, refunds, voids, payment links) also exclude disputes, so an agent would need to work from undocumented API surface. Missing for 10: documented dispute retrieval/list endpoints, evidence upload and submission endpoints, dispute tools in the MCP server, and hands-on corroboration of an agent completing a dispute workflow.
